title: elc-audit-engine 設計文件
summary: Finalized technical design for elc-audit-engine, a two-stage local pipeline for pre-submission medical record reinforcement and post-denial appeal generation via a shared comparison engine.
scope: 三方比對器 (三方比對 comparison engine: order/rule/record)
規則庫 (rule base: SQLite payment_rules, drug_rules, PageIndex rule_mapping, ChromaDB)
病歷彙整器 (medical record aggregator / Provider interface)
醫師審核流程 (physician review workflow, checkbox state machine)
申報 XML / 核減清單 parsers
錯誤處理與硬性檢查 (error handling and hard validation rules)
